metadata.name: PaperBoat
metadata.summary: Native PC port of Paper Mario 64 with enhanced rendering and customizable controls

content.value: PaperBoat is a native PC port of the classic Nintendo 64 title Paper Mario developed by the Harbour Masters team. Built upon reverse-engineered decompilation efforts and modern graphics runtimes, it brings the beloved storybook role-playing adventure to desktop operating systems with native performance and flexible visual backends.

The port requires a legally acquired retail game ROM dump to extract and assemble original game assets. Once configured, PaperBoat provides high-framerate rendering, customizable keyboard and gamepad bindings, and support for user mods and replacement texture packages.

items.value: Native PC rendering supporting high resolutions, arbitrary aspect ratios, and unlocked framerates
Multiple graphics backend options including OpenGL and DirectX with runtime switching
Full controller mapping with modern gamepads alongside customizable keyboard controls
Legitimate asset extraction pipeline powered by retail N64 Paper Mario ROM dumps
Support for custom game modifications and high-resolution texture asset packages
